existing_group_assignments.rationale: Same endpoint as 'Decrease, Fatty acid β-oxidation' (decreased fatty acid beta oxidation), so it is a same-direction synonym of that member.
Decreased fertility is the same event as 'Decrease, Fertility'.
placeholder
Impairment of learning and memory is the same endpoint as 'impaired, Learning and memory' and closely related to memory loss.
Increased pro-inflammatory mediators is a direct synonym of 'Increase, Pro-Inflammatory Mediators'.
Increased mortality is the same direction as reduced survival, so it fits the survival group, but the context differs.
Reduced prostaglandins in the ovary is the same decrease as reduced PGF2alpha in plasma or ovary synthesis, but the compartment or specificity differs.
Reduced reproductive success is the same endpoint as 'Decreased, Reproductive Success' and the opposite of 'Increased, Reproductive Success'.
CPT1A down-regulation is not a synonym of fatty acid beta-oxidation; omitted.
Decreased GnRH pulsatility/release is the same endpoint as the decreased hypothalamic GnRH release member, and is opposite to the increased GnRH secretion member.
Decreased LH surge is the same event as 'Decreased, LH Surge from anterior pituitary', with the tissue qualifier omitted.
Decreased fecundity in general, paired with the existing decreased fecundity events, one of which is generation-specific.
Decreased COUP-TFII in stem Leydig cells is the opposite direction to the 'Increased COUP-TFII in fetal Leydig cells' member.
Inhibition of the ERG (hERG) potassium channel shares the same channel object with hERG blockade and IKr inhibition, but the processes may differ.
Increased LH is the same event in the same direction as 'Increased, Leutinizing hormone (LH)' (spelling differs).
Nitric oxide depletion is not the same object as eNOS, so this is not assigned.
PPAR-alpha activation is the same signalling target as the existing PPAR activation/inhibition group but with a different isoform and direction, so it is flagged for curator review.
Suppression of estrogen receptor activity concerns the same receptor as the disruption and activation events but is a distinct process.
Calcineurin inhibition sits in the same calcineurin-NFAT signalling axis as the existing NFAT events, but it is a different object and process, so it is a weak fit.
Decreased T3 is a decrease in thyroid hormone without a specified compartment, compared with the serum and brain events.
Decreased plasma PGF2alpha concentration is the same reduction as the existing plasma member, with the same wording variant as the ovary-synthesis members.
Decreased sodium conductance 2 is related to the existing decreased sodium conductance 1 and sodium channel function events, for curator review.
Inhibition of deiodinase 3 is another deiodinase isoform alongside the existing isoform-specific inhibition events.
Lung fibrosis is the same process as the existing 'Pulmonary fibrosis' member, in a different organ context from liver fibrosis.
HIF-1 activation concerns the same HIF-1 object as the HIF-1 heterodimer events, but is a distinct process.
Lipid Peroxidation is the same lipid oxidation process as 'Increase, Lipid peroxidation', but without an increase direction or a membrane qualifier, so it is flagged for curator review.
Decreased locomotor activity is the same endpoint as 'Decreased, locomotion' and the opposite direction to 'Increased, locomotion'.
Oxidative DNA damage is a specific form of increased DNA damage, same direction, so it fits the general-versus-specific context group.
Increased DNA damage and mutation is the same direction as general DNA damage increase, with added specificity (mutation).
Population trajectory decline is the same endpoint as Decline, Population, and is opposite in direction to Increased, Population.
Increase cell proliferation is the general form of the same process, which the group lists with cell-type-specific variants.
Decrease, Reproduction is a closely related general reproductive output decrease, but this is a stretch, so only the clear matches are kept.
Increase, Necrosis is the same process as the Necrosis / Necrotic Tissue events in that group, differing only in wording or specificity.
Induced Ang II accumulation describes increased angiotensin II, the same as the other members of that group.
Inhibition of fatty acid oxidation is the same endpoint as decreased fatty acid beta-oxidation, so it fits this group, which already pairs the increase and decrease directions.
Pulmonary inflammation is the same process (inflammation) as the group's other events, set in a lung-specific context.
Activation of the inflammation pathway is a general increased-inflammation event and fits the group's mix of general and context-specific events.

Decreased ionotropic GABA receptor chloride channel conductance shares the same GABA-gated chloride channel object as the increased chloride conductance and activation events but is a distinct process and direction, so it is flagged for curator review.
Liver dysfunction is closely related to liver injury/hepatotoxicity, although it is not a strict synonym, so this is a borderline assignment.
Impaired locomotor function is a decrease in locomotion, a directional counterpart of the same endpoint (Increased, locomotion).
Cardiac fibrosis is the same fibrosis process in a different organ context from liver and pulmonary fibrosis.
Mitochondrial Complex I inhibition is a sibling of other complex-specific inhibition events, but it is a different complex.
Binding of QB site in D1 protein of Photosystem II shares the Photosystem II object with the inhibition events but is a binding process.
"Decreased, Glycolysis" is the same endpoint and direction as "Decrease, Glycolysis", and the group already pairs it with the opposite "Increase, Glycolysis".
"Increase, SREBF1" concerns the same protein as "Activation, SREBF1" and is opposite in direction to "Inhibition, SREBP1c".

"Increase, Lipid degradation" is closely related to increased fatty acid beta-oxidation, with the same direction as "Increase, Fatty acid beta-oxidation" and the opposite direction to the decrease member.
"Decrease, Cell growth" is a general cell-level decrease similar to "Decrease, Cell proliferation".
"Reduced fertility / fecundity" describes decreased fertility, the same as "Decrease, Fertility".
'Increase, lipid accumulation' is a synonym of 'increased lipid accumulation'.
Kidney fibrosis is the same fibrosis process in another organ context, like liver and pulmonary fibrosis.
Activation of PPARγ concerns PPAR signalling, like the PPAR-gamma activation / PPAR alpha inhibition group.

new_groups.rationale: Reduced testosterone synthesis in different cell contexts (Leydig cells vs ovarian theca cells).
Reduced vitellogenin synthesis in liver vs reduced plasma vitellogenin concentration, different compartments and processes.
Both concern AhR signalling; activation and AHR/ARNT dimerization are distinct processes.
Both concern oxidative stress; one is an increase and the other is decreased protection, so context differs.
placeholder
Both concern glucocorticoid receptor agonist activation, one in the context of fetal Leydig cell testosterone reduction.
Both relate adult Leydig cell apoptosis to decreased steroidogenesis or testosterone, with differently specified KERs.
Both describe impaired development, one general and one specific to the larval stage.
Both concern norepinephrine receptors on GnRH neurons, with binding reduced versus receptor antagonism, which are distinct processes.
Increased inhibitory postsynaptic potential and increased neuronal synaptic inhibition both describe enhanced inhibitory neurotransmission.
Both describe induction of muscle paralysis, in somatic muscle versus pharyngeal muscle.
Smooth muscle proliferation/clonal expansion and hypertrophy/hyperplasia both describe increased smooth muscle cell growth.
Both describe ovarian hyperplasia in different cell compartments (stromal cells vs epithelium).
Both describe promotion of ovarian tumours of different types (adenomas vs granular cell tumours).
Increased fibrosarcoma, liposarcoma, and hemangiosarcoma are the same type of tumour increase in different mesenchymal cell types.
Both describe decreased E2 concentrations, in hypothalamus blood vs ovary.
Decreased kisspeptin release from AVPV neurons and decreased kisspeptin stimulation of GnRH neurons are closely related kisspeptin-axis decreases that differ in context.
Decreased vs increased T3 in tissues are opposite directions of the same endpoint.
Collagen deposition is a specific ECM change, whereas modulation of ECM composition is a general ECM process, so they differ in specificity.
Increased seizure and increased epilepsy are closely related hyperexcitability outcomes that differ in specificity.

Decreased atRA concentration, decreased RAR activation and decreased ALDH1A activity all concern the retinoic acid signaling axis but are distinct molecules and processes, so they are flagged for curator review.
Both concern the GnRH receptor; promoter hypermethylation and decreased expression are distinct processes.
LH receptor antagonism and impaired ovulation are not the same object, so this should be omitted.
Both describe decreased motile cilia function or structure in airway epithelium, at different levels of specificity (beat frequency vs number/length).
Prolonged action potential duration at the cellular level and QT interval prolongation at the organ/ECG level describe the same repolarization delay at different scales.
Both concern the folate transporter, one as an affected transporter and the other as decreased folate uptake, which are distinct processes.
All concern hemocyanin but describe distinct processes (mRNA expression, oxygen binding capacity, oxidation of the active site).
Decreased sodium in different compartments (gill uptake vs plasma concentration).
Both concern PPAR, as activation versus dysregulated transcriptional expression within PPAR signaling.
Vascular endothelial dysfunction and vascular barrier disruption are similar vascular impairments with differing specificity.
Inhibition of different thyroid hormone transporters (MCT8 and OATP1C1), which are distinct isoforms of the same event type.
Diminished survival, proliferation and differentiation of B lymphocytes are different processes in the same cell type, grouped for curator review.
Increased transcription of different dopamine signaling genes (transporter and receptor).
Both concern 11β-HSD activity, but they involve different isozymes (type 1 vs type 2) and opposite directions, so they are flagged for review.
Both describe altered bile acid levels or composition in different compartments.
